name: ascent-security
description: Security checks for any repository: .env discipline, hardcoded credentials, container privilege, nginx security headers, production URLs, dynamic code execution, dependencies (lockfiles, pinning, sources, licences, offline vulnerability scans of packages and local images), a STRIDE threat model, and live checks of a running application the operator runs (headers, verbs, traversal, unauthenticated writes, body limits, disclosure, prompt injection, AI rate limits, ZAP, nuclei and dalfox reports), plus a security-auditor agent. Partly generated from the ASCENT framework's template skills.
